newsitem.title: USA: AM Int'l to hold vote on reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: AM Int'l to hold vote on reverse stock split.

text.p: AM International Inc said Thursday its shareholders will vote on a proposal for a one-for-two-and-a-half reverse stock split at its annual meeting, scheduled for May 28.
Shareholders will also vote on a proposal to change the company's name to Multigraphics Inc.
As previously announced, AM said it declared a $2.00 per common share dividend. The dividend is payable on May 27 to shareholders of record on May 13.
The company said it anticipates the dividend payment will be treated as a return of capital distribution and will be funded with cash and cash equivalents currently on hand, now about $27 million.
The company said it currently has about 7.04 million shares outstanding.
